Subject: SOC2 intake - access evidence needed (SCIM/SAML/RBAC)

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC2 intake we need a compact access lineage dossier from Redwood covering:
- SCIM delta for the last 90 days (includes create/patch/replace/delete events with timestamps and actor)
- SAML assertion samples for interactive login flows (with timestamps and assertion IDs)
- Role -> permission matrix and any owner/steward mapping
- Service account inventory and justification for elevated privileges
- Short note on least-privilege enforcement (how role assignments are reviewed/approved)

Target deadline is EOD May 18 to sync with our auditor (VeriSafe). We can accept a password-protected bundle on SFTP or a shared Drive folder. Also let us know if any items require redaction or NDAs. CC'ing procurement and our audits team.

Appreciate a point person and ETA.

Best,
Samir
